content: Vite | Next Generation Frontend Tooling. Blazing fast frontend build tool powering the next generation of web applications. Instant Server Start, Lightning Fast HMR, Rich Features Out of the Box, Optimized Build. Rich Features Out of the Box: TypeScript, JSX, CSS.
conclusion: Vite 是现代前端构建工具，提供极速 HMR 与基于 Rollup/Rolldown 的优化静态构建，输出纯静态 SPA 文件。
